🏋️What's best for the business of wrestling promotion All Elite Wrestling is for David Ellison-led Paramount Skydance is to get a pinned victory in its deal for Warner Bros. Discovery.

"I think that's [the deal] fantastic. I'm so excited about it. And you asked me about the opportunities for @AEW and I think that's a huge opportunity for AEW because we've premiered our pay-per-view on HBO Max and we have a great audience. And now with Paramount making a deal to acquire HBO Max, for me as a show-runner that's worked at Warner Brothers for over seven years now, I have to say I'm very excited about it and really welcoming of the ownership from Paramount," AEW founder and CEO @TonyKhan said in a new drop of my Power Players podcast on @YahooFinance.

Really enjoyed hearing Tony chat about what he has learned about business from his father.
